WorkStream · Evidence Retrieval Agent

Jira is where the evidence already lives

Customers connect Jira more than anything else, but almost nobody uses it to collect audit proof, they do it by hand, and about 30% of those tasks get reopened for rework. An agent pulls the sampled change tickets onto the control task itself and marks up what the request names. One worked example below, on real Jira responses: ITGC-CHG-02, program change management for BillPro, twelve samples from Q1 FY2026.
